newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TRADE DEFICIT 3.9 BLN KROONS IN Q1 - CUSTOMS.
newsitem.headline: TRADE DEFICIT 3.9 BLN KROONS IN Q1 - CUSTOMS.

text.p: Estonia's trade deficit was at 3.9 billion kroons in the first quarter of 1997 compared with a 2.8 billion kroon deficit in the same period of 1996, the customs board said on Friday.

The customs figures are not considered as the most reliable indicator of Estonia's trade balance as they are based on customs declarations only and do not include financial transfers and exports of commodities such as electrical energy.
The customs board said in a statement that exports came to 8.4 billion kroons while imports were 12.3 billion kroons in the first quarter.
In March, the trade deficit was 1.4 billion kroons, compared with 1.2 billion kroons a year ago. Estonia's exports were at 3.1 billion kroons in March and imports at 4.5 billion kroons.
The major trading partner in the first quarter was Finland with 17.4 percent of total exports and 32 percent of total imports.
